name: Norman Lee
source: A devout servant of the lord, Father Norman is ever enthusiastic about sharing the message of the lord. He’s a well known figure among the locals of Luxbourne, especially with the Anglican and Christian communities, and is often sought out for spiritual and religious guidance. Very active, when he’s not holding service, he is always available and ready for blessings, baptisms, weddings and the likes.
